items.question: How accurate is the contract analysis?
items.answer: Our AI model has learned from thousands of case laws and legal data to detect risks with over 95% accuracy. However, we recommend consulting with a professional lawyer for final judgment.

items.question: Is my uploaded contract safe?
items.answer: All documents are immediately encrypted and destroyed after analysis. Your personal information and contract details are thoroughly protected.

items.question: Can I download the analysis results?
items.answer: Yes, you can download the results in PDF format after analysis is complete. Premium members can also download the modified contract.

items.question: What's the difference between free and paid versions?
items.answer: The free version allows 2 analyses per month, while the paid version includes unlimited analysis, expert consultation, and automatic contract correction features.
